answer: Hardware attestation ties each agent to one physical signal of trust. To register, an agent must prove it runs inside a sealed enclave whose chip key the maker certified, and each chip can back only one identity at a time. A Sybil army cannot bloom like a lotus from one laptop: every fake needs its own certified device, and if a chip key is caught signing for two agents, the tide turns and both are revoked. The attacker's cost becomes real hardware per identity, not free keypairs.
